sweepNotes: Re-reviewed official Alpaca SDK and searched current GitHub market-data/websocket projects. No new dependency promoted directly to production. Weak/unverified generic scanner repos were not admitted to registry without sufficient docs/tests/license evidence.

candidates.purpose: Official REST/WebSocket/SSE market-data, news-stream and paper-trading SDK; candidate for future event-stream benchmark against polling.
candidates.maintenance: Official repository updated 2026-08-25 and pushed 2026-08-24 at review time.
candidates.docsTests: README documents REST, WebSocket and SSE clients, StockDataStream/NewsDataStream, typed request models and runtime pydantic validation.
candidates.securityNotes: Requires API credentials; never expose keys in GitHub Pages/browser. Paper and data credentials must remain server-side and isolated.
candidates.lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW for live stream when event timestamps are preserved; MEDIUM if historical backfill is merged into signal-time state without event-time boundaries.
candidates.integrationPlan: Do not install in production. Benchmark a sandbox StockDataStream adapter versus current polling for p50/p95 event latency, disconnect recovery, coverage, TPM/turnover feature lift and cost before any integration.

newSearchOutcome.reason: Returned generic/crypto/TradingView wrappers did not exceed current official candidates on provenance, tests, licensing clarity, equities suitability or integration safety.
